description: Scene Pack 4: concatenates the channels of up to four cables into one polyphonic cable, so Room Reverb can place each of them as a separate source in the room

inputs.text: One bundle of sources; its channels are copied into the output in order, after those of any input before it

outputs.text: The packed sources, one to a channel, at most eight

notes: the inputs are packed in order and anything past the eighth channel is dropped
a patched cable carrying no channels is kept as an empty bundle rather than becoming a silent source, so chained Scene Packs stay in order
